gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare, about 360 metres long, commencing from the junction of Cheng Tu Road and Wu Pak Street running in a westerly direction, then in a northerly direction, then turning in an easterly direction and joining Cheng Tu Road near Sai On Street, as shown coloured red on drawing No. HH 3469.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道全長約三百六十公尺，由成都道與湖北街交界起，向西伸展，續轉向北，然後轉向東，與成都道近西安街處會合，其位置在 HH 3469 號圖則上以紅色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare, about 36 metres long, commencing at its junction with Nam Ning Street, running in a westerly direction, and joining Aberdeen Main Road, as shown coloured green on drawing No. HH 3469.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道全長約三十六公尺，起點與南寧街會合，向西伸展，與香港仔大道會合，其位置在 HH 3469 號圖則上以綠色標明。
